statements.markdown: **Theorem 6.22 (Residue-class and odd-support irrationality).** *For integers $b\ge2$, $m\ge1$ and a residue $c$, $\sum_{\substack{n\ge1\\n\equiv c\pmod m}}(b^n-1)^{-1}$ is irrational. Specializing $m=2,c=1$: $\sum_{n\text{ odd}} 1/(b^n-1)$ is irrational for every $b\ge 2$, the case treated explicitly in \[[3](#ref-lucatachiya2017), Example 2, p. 140\].*
